method: manual visual transcription from the exact supplied images using fifteen separate view_image calls with detail="original", after viewing, saving and reading back the five-image preflight record. Preflight observations were preserved unchanged. Native, usage720 and thumbnail320 were each actually displayed for X3255, X5251, X7713, X4979 and X4097 in that order. Every complete supplied text item was read from usage720 pixels and checked at native; thumbnail views assessed first attention and reduction. No OCR, crops, substitute images, web, connectors, agents, other profiles, or prohibited sources were used. The tool accepted original detail and displayed the full images; portrait usage720 is 720 x 1080, landscape usage720 is 720 x 480, and portrait/landscape thumbnails have a 320-pixel long edge. Rendered glyphs cannot certify a dash Unicode code point. PNG headers were read only to verify dimensions: both squares are 1254 x 1254, both portraits 1024 x 1536, and the landscape 1536 x 1024, all with 0% native ratio error. Scores concern visible execution of the explicitly requested clay 3D, raised Korean letters and strong complements. They make no claim about authorship, actual movement, physical mechanics or printing. closest_pair.score applies the provided diversity scale to the pair (1 repetitive, 3 distinct with shared structural habits, 5 strongly differentiated). No scores are averaged.
